name: DECISION REGISTER — 5 decisions unblock the docs increment and close a live P0 exposure (D1 by 25 Nov 12:00Z)
description:
Opened 2026-11-24 (shift #14) because the board carries **13 cards in `onhold` with past `wake_at` values** (a8be6182, 6c697929, 60917b9a, 68566d25, 7567eaae, 82314f38, 42c8d580, 17efa3eb, 0f73b32b, 19883bdd, c8c30166, 8909f356, 4f0e5a19) plus `e27a5d03` and `537e8ee7`. They are not 15 separate problems: **five decisions** unblock all of them. This card is the register; each item below carries the option, the recommendation and a decide-by date.

Answer with one line per item, e.g. `D1 yes · D2 provision npm · D3 yes · D4 C · D5 internal note`.

---

### D1 — Run the one-line hotfix now? **Decide by 25 Nov 12:00Z** (today+1)
Live site still publishes the two P0 review pages, because the `srcExclude` line is uncommitted (`HEAD` has none). Card `ec0a31db` holds the exact command.
- **A — commit only `.vitepress/config.mts` today** ✅ *recommended*: 1 line, reversible, independent of npm and of the content increment.
- B — hold it and ship it inside the content increment on 27 Nov → 2–3 extra days of public exposure.

### D2 — JS toolchain: fix it or waive it? **Decide by 26 Nov 12:00Z**
Evidence: `package.json` declares `"test": "vitest run"` + `vitest ^2.1.9`; `package-lock.json` contains **0** matches for `vitest`; QA suite `npm` is `available=false`. Result: every gate blocks with `[high] tests.no-runner` and **0 tests execute**. Four cards queue behind it (`537e8ee7`, `49007737`, `f247ada9`, `d0908965`).
- **A — provision npm on the host, then `cd docs && npm install && npm test`** ✅ *recommended*: unlocks the 12-case suite permanently; ~30 min of a shell-capable person.
- B — waive the JS gate: state in `docs/delivery-contract.md` that the docs suite is advisory and gates fall back to review only. Cheaper today, leaves the suite decorative and every "green" unverified.
- C — keep blocking: no docs change can be accepted until a shell exists. Honest, but the increment stalls indefinitely.

### D3 — Publish the content increment? **Decide by 27 Nov 12:00Z**
The pending tree is **13 content files, +750/−95** (measured 14:5xZ, `.codx` excluded). Card `e27a5d03`.
- Ship (recommended): `getting-started.md`, `features/browser-use.md`, `features/index.md`, `features/company-spaces.md` (untracked — closes the **live** dead link at `features/index.md:34`), `installer-refactor.md`, `local-models-cpu-strategy.md`, `qa/README.md`, `qa/tests/site-integrity.test.mts`.
- Leave out of the customer site (srcExcluded anyway): `transformation/company-first-shell.md`, `transformation/autonomous-company-{roadmap.md,backlog.yaml}`, `transformation/dsh-engine-parity.md` — commit them in a second, internal-only commit.
- Precondition: biblio's truthfulness verdict on the 3 unowned pages (card `68566d25`, overdue since 20 Nov — delegated this shift).

### D4 — QA gate root: open the platform root (A) or register `docs/` as a sub-project (C)? **Decide by 28 Nov**
Card `b776e9a7`. A gates `api/` + `client/` but makes every docs count noisy; C keeps the gate meaningful for docs and leaves the platform ungated until `42c8d580` lands. *Recommendation: C, plus `42c8d580` scheduled the same week.*

### D5 — Disclose the exposure that already happened? **Decide by 28 Nov**
Card `60917b9a`. The two P0 pages were publicly reachable (unlinked, but in the local search index) from the first build until the hotfix deploys.
- **A — purge caches + request Archive.org exclusion + short internal security note** ✅ *recommended*: no public statement while P0-6 (unauthenticated proxied apps) is still unfixed.
- B — full public advisory: only after P0-6 is fixed, and it needs a named owner.
- C — no action: record the acceptance of the exposure.

---

**Cost of no answer:** the tree keeps growing (24 files on 23 Nov → 62 today), each gate stays red, and the security exposure stays live. Every shift without an answer re-delivers this card.

## PM shift #14 — closing note: two overdue cards folded in behind this register (annex, no new decision numbers)

The board listing still showed two cards whose wakes had expired and that no turn of this shift had re-armed. Both are now parked behind the decisions on this register instead of waking daily:

| card | what it is | why it waits | new wake |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `17efa3eb` (M5) | make the security reviewer attributable: aggregate by rule+path, never publish a block without a reachable `path:line`, align the paths-filter root | same capability gap as D2 — the fix lives in `api/`, not reachable from this project root, and nothing here can run its tests | **28 Nov 13:00Z** (with `7567eaae`, `6c697929`, `19883bdd`, `0f73b32b`) |
| `c8c30166` | conditional follow-up: extend `.codx` ignore coverage to `api/.codx` and the repo-root `.codx` — **only if** M6 is accepted as docs-only | genuinely conditional on M6 (`8909f356`), so it must not be acted on before M6 is resolved | **1 Dec 13:00Z** (after M6's 28 Nov checkpoint) |

### State of the register at the end of this shift

- **D1** (one-line `srcExclude` commit, card `ec0a31db`) — **still open, deadline 25 Nov 12:00Z**. This is the only decision with an external-facing clock: until that commit lands, the live site keeps serving the two internal P0 review pages. Prior shifts recorded this as "fixed"; it is not — the exclusion exists only in the working tree.
- **D3** (publish / hold the three unowned pages) — the verdict card `68566d25` has been taken off the work queue: three runs confirmed the tools are jailed to `docs/` while the code lives in `api/` + `client/`, so no agent can produce that verdict. It now waits on this register (wake 27 Nov 13:00Z). Do not re-dispatch it.
- **D2** (JS toolchain / `npm`) — unchanged, `537e8ee7` 26 Nov.
- **D4** (read access to `api/` + `client/` for the review tools) — unchanged, decide by 28 Nov.

No card on `IT team / Review` for a second consecutive shift; that trigger decision is `b4761be7` (26 Nov) and is separate from this register.

*PM, shift #14, 2026-11-24.*

## D1 is WITHDRAWN — the register shrinks to D2–D5 (2026-11-24 17:5xZ)

**D1 ("commit `.vitepress/config.mts` to stop the live publication") is no longer a decision.**
Verified today: the diff of `.vitepress/config.mts` against `HEAD` is **+1/-0** and the added line is the
`/features/company-spaces` sidebar entry. `srcExclude` (`config.mts:13`) is **inside `HEAD` already**. The
exposure was closed at commit level without any human action; the hotfix card `ec0a31db` is closed as
already satisfied.

**What survives of D1 is a verification, not a decision** — one browser check, no approval needed:
open the two review URLs on the public site and record whether they 404. That is step 0 of the new
runbook card (IT team / User action needed / due 25 Nov), and it is also on `60917b9a`.

**Still open and still needing management:**
- **D2** — `npm install` and commit the regenerated `docs/package-lock.json` (0 `vitest` entries today, so
  the 12-case docs suite cannot execute). ~5 min, reversible.
- **D3** — HOLD or PUBLISH the three unowned pages (`browser-use.md`, `voice-conversation.md`,
  `suggested-replies.md`). Note `browser-use.md`'s prose defect is fixed and now guarded (`97583327`
  closed today), so "hold" is about attribution, not correctness.
- **D4** — `security_audit` reads outside the project via `..` (`0f73b32b`).
- **D5** — CISO gate trigger, event vs. commit boundary (`b4761be7`).

**Recommendation unchanged:** D2 = do it; D3 = HOLD; D4/D5 = accept as known, schedule after the
increment ships. Decide-by: **25 Nov 12:00Z** for D2/D3, 27 Nov for D4/D5.

## D3 rewritten — it is now ONE file, and "hold" is the wrong option (2026-11-24 17:5xZ)

The register described D3 as "hold or publish the 3 unowned pages". That framing is stale. Measured today with
`project_changes(scope="all", paths=["features/voice-conversation.md","features/suggested-replies.md","features/browser-use.md","features/company-spaces.md"])`:

- `features/voice-conversation.md` — **no diff vs HEAD** → already committed and already published. It cannot be held; it is live.
- `features/suggested-replies.md` — **no diff vs HEAD** → same.
- **`features/browser-use.md` — `M`, +292/-5, uncommitted.**
- `features/company-spaces.md` — **untracked**, 120 lines, and `.vitepress/config.mts` already carries a nav link to it.

**So D3 is one question:** publish `features/browser-use.md` or leave the current published version live?

**Why the answer is now "publish" — this reverses the previous recommendation:**
1. Leaving it uncommitted does **not** hold anything back. The live page keeps the **wrong** claim that the browser
   recording/script routes are mirrored under `/api/computers`. Holding the fix *is* shipping the defect
   (card `97583327` is reopened on exactly this point).
2. The correctness objection is gone: the prose is fixed and now covered by a route-claim guard in
   `qa/tests/site-integrity.test.mts` (12 cases, incl. a pre-fix-wording red fixture).
3. `config.mts` cannot ship without it anyway — its only pending line is the nav entry for the untracked
   `company-spaces.md`, so the increment is already a 3-file commit.

**Revised D3 recommendation: PUBLISH** `browser-use.md` + `company-spaces.md` + `config.mts` in one commit, after the
lockfile fix and a green `npx vitest run`. Execution is runbook `6e29792a` step 4 (due 25 Nov).

The remaining honesty gap is attribution, not correctness: nobody has verified `voice-conversation.md`'s two
contradictory barge-in statements (`:50-54` vs `:182-183`, card `a06cad39`), and that page is **already published**.
That is a separate, smaller risk and does not block the commit.

⚠️ THE TITLE OF THIS CARD IS STALE — read the register below it, not the title.

- **"D1 by 25 Nov 12:00Z" is withdrawn.** The `srcExclude` line is already committed in `HEAD`; the one-line diff on `.vitepress/config.mts` is the company-spaces nav link, not the exclusion. There is no hotfix to approve. Card `ec0a31db` is closed.
- **D3 is no longer "hold the 3 unowned pages".** Two of the three are already published with no diff; only `browser-use.md` needed work, and that work is now **done in the tree** (`41ec27a7`): the duplicated route list is gone, recipe deletion is stated once at item level, and it ships with the increment.
- **Live decisions are D2 and D4/D5** — the commit (`6e29792a`) and the disclosure question (`60917b9a`). D2 is the only one with a clock: **25 Nov 12:00Z**, and it is a 5-minute shell session.

Everything else in this register stands.
